name: Forsyth County Sheriff's Office Pet Adoption & Resource Center (PARC)
notes: Forsyth's county shelter, now run by the Sheriff's Office, with Weekend Warrior and longer-term foster options.

name: Hall County Animal Shelter
notes: Low adoption fees, plus Doggie Day Out and Weekend Warriors programs if you want to foster a dog short-term.

name: Gwinnett County Animal Welfare (Bill Atkinson Animal Welfare Center)
notes: Gwinnett's open-admission shelter, open six days a week, with late hours on the first Monday of each month.

name: Fulton County Animal Services
address: 1251 Fulton Industrial Blvd NW, Atlanta, GA 30336
notes: Fulton's county shelter, open seven days a week; fosters get vet care, food and a crate from LifeLine.

name: Cherokee County Animal Shelter
notes: Cherokee County's shelter in Canton; adopts to people from any county.

name: Dawson County Humane Society
notes: Dawson County's adoption shelter beside Rock Creek Park; calling ahead for an appointment is recommended.

name: Humane Society of Forsyth County
notes: Nonprofit shelter in Cumming that welcomes walk-ins and also runs a low-cost clinic and pet food pantry.

name: Humane Society of Northeast Georgia
notes: Gainesville adoption center open Tuesday through Sunday afternoons, with a low-cost pet clinic on site.

name: Atlanta Humane Society - Roswell
notes: Cat adoptions and Thursday vaccine clinics, plus dog adoption events on select Saturdays.

name: Society of Humane Friends of Georgia
notes: Gwinnett rescue whose pets live in foster homes; adoptions by appointment only.

name: Furkids Animal Rescue & Shelters
notes: Dog shelter at its Cumming headquarters plus adoption centers in Johns Creek, Suwanee and Buford pet stores.

name: Angels Among Us Pet Rescue
notes: Large foster-based rescue with a foster network across north metro Atlanta.

name: Cherokee Humane Society
notes: Dogs live in foster homes; adoptions run through PetSmart and Petco partner sites.

name: Releash Atlanta
notes: Foster-based dog rescue with a Buford mailing address; reach them by email.

name: Dirt Road Doggies Rescue
notes: Foster-based dog rescue serving Hall, Banks, Jackson and Gwinnett counties.

name: Labrador Friends of the South
notes: Lab rescue for north Georgia; adopters meet dogs in the metro Atlanta area.

name: Atlanta Lab Rescue
notes: Volunteer Lab and Lab-mix rescue that averages 400+ adoptions a year, with foster-to-adopt options.

name: Adopt a Golden Atlanta
notes: Golden retriever rescue that is always looking for more foster homes.

name: Atlanta Boxer Rescue
notes: Boxer rescue serving the greater Atlanta area for more than 18 years.

name: German Shepherd Dog Rescue of Georgia
notes: German shepherds cared for in volunteer foster homes around metro Atlanta and north Georgia.

name: DREAM Dachshund Rescue
notes: All-volunteer dachshund rescue serving metro Atlanta.
